title: Spatiotemporal and Multi-Robot Motion Planning on Graphs of Space-Time Convex Sets
abstract: arXiv:2607.00444v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decoupled multi-robot motion planning avoids the high-dimensional joint configuration space but requires repeated single-robot planning among moving obstacles, where route choice and timing are coupled. We develop a framework based on graphs of space-time convex sets (ST-GCSs) for continuous spatiotemporal planning and multi-robot coordination. An ST-GCS represents collision-free space-time by convex sets, allowing the sequence of regions and the geometry and timing of piecewise-linear trajectories to be optimized jointly under velocity limits. To incorporate moving obstacles and previously planned robots, we develop Exact Convex Decomposition (ECD), which removes their swept occupancies while maintaining a convex decomposition for subsequent planning queries. translated_title: 基于时空凸集图的时空与多机器人运动规划
translated_abstract: 解耦式多机器人运动规划避免了高维联合构型空间，但需要在移动障碍物中反复进行单机器人规划，其中路线选择与时序安排相互耦合。我们开发了一个基于时空凸集图（ST-GCS）的框架，用于连续时空规划与多机器人协调。ST-GCS 用凸集表示无碰撞时空，使得区域序列与分段线性轨迹的几何形状和时序能够在速度限制下进行联合优化。为了纳入移动障碍物和先前已规划的机器人，我们开发了精确凸分解（ECD），它在移除这些物体的扫掠占据的同时，仍保持凸分解结构以供后续规划查询使用。基于基于路径的 GCS 搜索，我们开发了一个针对 ST-GCS 运动模型定制的最佳优先求解器，利用时间可达性进行支配剪枝，并使用……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于时空凸集图（ST-GCS）的运动规划框架，通过精确凸分解（ECD）处理移动障碍物与已规划机器人的扫掠占据，联合优化区域序列、轨迹几何与时序，实现解耦式多机器人连续时空协调规划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a motion planning framework based on graphs of space-time convex sets (ST-GCSs), introducing Exact Convex Decomposition (ECD) to remove swept occupancies of moving obstacles and previously planned robots, jointly optimizing region sequences, trajectory geometry, and timing for decoupled multi-robot spatiotemporal coordination.
